articles.title: Returns and exchanges
articles.text: Unused gear can be returned within 60 days for a refund to the original payment method. Damaged on arrival items are replaced free, and we email a prepaid label within one business day.

articles.title: Tent and shelter warranty
articles.text: Poles, zips and seams are covered for 2 years. A broken pole is replaced by mail, so the customer keeps the tent. Photos of the break speed up the claim.

articles.title: Shipping times
articles.text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days by UPS Ground. Orders placed before 1pm Pacific leave the same day.

order_system.name: on-premises SAP ERP over a site-to-site VPN

articles.title: Lead times for brake components
articles.text: Composite brake blocks ship from the Leeds warehouse in 5 working days. Cast iron blocks are made to order, with a lead time of 6 weeks.

articles.title: Expediting an order
articles.text: An order can be expedited for a fee of 8 percent of the order value when stock exists in another warehouse. The account manager confirms the new date in writing.

articles.title: Certificates of conformity
articles.text: Every safety-critical part ships with a certificate of conformity. A missing certificate is reissued from the ERP within 24 hours.

articles.title: Backorders
articles.text: Backordered items ship as soon as stock arrives, with no extra shipping charge. A customer can cancel a backordered line at any time before it ships.

articles.title: Substitute products
articles.text: When a glove or mask is backordered, support may offer an equivalent product from the approved substitute list at the same price.

articles.title: Invoices and credit
articles.text: Invoices are due in 30 days. A credit for a short shipment is applied to the next invoice automatically.

articles.title: Change or skip a delivery
articles.text: Subscribers can skip, delay or change a delivery up to 3 days before it ships, from the account page or by asking support.

articles.title: Food that a pet will not eat
articles.text: If a pet refuses a new food, we refund the first bag in full and suggest a different protein. The customer does not need to send it back.

articles.title: Billing dates
articles.text: A subscription is charged on the day its box ships, not the day it was ordered.
